{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA orders sample:", qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status']].head().values)

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]
print("Shape after removing QA orders:", df_clean.shape)

# Verify QA orders are gone
qa_check = df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders still present:", len(qa_check))

# Check for refunded orders
df_clean['status'].value_counts()"}
